tests.title: Customer filters narrow results by registration date, member level, and source platform
tests.goal: Customer directory filters return only records matching the selected criteria.
preconditions: Dedicated Storeberry Flower staging admin account is configured in local .env.
data: Registration-date range and member level selected from available controls.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Customers > Customers.
Open Filter and select a registration-date range and member level; apply the filter.
Reset the filter, select a source platform such as POS, ESHOP, or CMS, and apply it.

expected.text: Every result matches the selected date range and member level in the first filtered view.
Every result in the second view matches the selected source platform.
Counts are dynamic and customer personal data is not copied into reports.
